label: extension

args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo and would like to enquire about availability for a group of 10 people during the month of June.

Could you please let me know:
1. Whether you have availability for 10 guests in June, and which dates would be possible?
2. Any group booking rates or discounts you may offer.
3. What room/capsule configurations would be available to accommodate our group.

We are somewhat flexible on exact dates within June, so please share the options that would suit us best. I would appreciate any additional details about your group booking process.

Thank you very much for your time, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
args.subject: Group Booking Enquiry - Availability for 10 People in June

2. **Sent the enquiry email** to **groups@cityhub-tokyo.jp** from your address (emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com), asking about:
